chunks: Whoever looks at a woman, then raises his gaze to the sky or closes his eyes, his sight will not return to him until Allah marries him to the Hoor al-'Ayn.
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for lowering the gaze after looking at a woman?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches restraint of the gaze and encourages immediate turning away after an improper look. It presents a reward in the afterlife for one who controls his sight for the sake of Allah.
